summary: Iteration 83 - Admin Sidebar Restructuring & Workspace-Scoped Team Access Testing Complete. All 11 backend tests passed. All frontend UI tests verified sidebar structure for workspace admins (Admin section with 5 links) and superadmins (Enterprise section with 3 links), workspace-scoped user list, role editing, and page access.
critical_code_review_comments: Workspace admin sidebar correctly shows 'Admin' section with 5 links: Organisations, Discord App Setup, Team & Access, Analytics, API Key Usage
Workspace admin sidebar correctly hides 'Enterprise', 'Workspace Settings', and 'Platform Admin' sections
Workspace admin sidebar correctly hides the '+' button for creating new workspaces
Superadmin sidebar correctly shows 'Enterprise' section with 3 links: Workspaces, Team & Access, Discord App Setup
Superadmin sidebar correctly shows the '+' button for creating new workspaces
Superadmin sidebar correctly hides 'Admin' and 'Workspace Settings' sections
GET /api/admin/users returns workspace-scoped users for workspace admins (3 users) vs all users for superadmins
Workspace admin can access /admin/team page and see only workspace-scoped users
Workspace admin can edit workspace roles (admin/member) via Edit User modal
Workspace admin cannot change platform-level roles (returns 403)
Workspace admin cannot delete superadmin users (returns 400)
Workspace admin can access /admin/organisations, /admin/analytics, /admin/api-key-analytics pages without 403
Workspace admin can invite new team members via Invite User modal
UI correctly hides edit/delete buttons for owner and superadmin users
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin sidebar restructuring complete. Key data-testids: nav-organisations, nav-discord-app-setup, nav-team-&-access, nav-analytics, nav-api-key-usage (Admin section for workspace admins), nav-workspaces (Enterprise section for superadmins), new-workspace-btn (only visible for superadmins), invite-user-btn, edit-user-modal, user-row-{id}, edit-user-{id}, delete-user-{id}, reset-pw-{id}. Sidebar uses isSuperAdmin check (user.role === 'superadmin' || user.platform_role === 'superadmin') to show Enterprise vs Admin sections. require_admin_or_ws_admin dependency allows workspace admins/owners to access admin endpoints with workspace-scoped data.
